Make sure the video is a straight-on, clear shot, of a person talking or singing. And make sure the photo you choose is also a clear, head-on face, that is centered in the frame. If you got all of that, the video comes out perfectly! It also didn’t take long to generate or save the created content 😀

reviews.text: I love it but you need to make it better . I Love the office. My name is Morgan

KEY FEATURES MISSING for PRO!!. I’m subscribed to the Pro version of this app. It goes to show you that I actually like the app and everything is good. But, I felt like I mostly didn’t have any control of what the final picture quality/output will look like.

At least for PRO users, i feel like the below features would be make the app great not just good. 

Feature 1 It would be great to have the ability (a feature) to edit the area of the face that the AI is working to animate. The user should be allowed to edit the selection as many times as he wants, I think maybe a permanent button on the edit screen after choosing a photo would be ideal. This will be a great help for the user to make sure that the final output is as desired. 

Feature 2 It would also be great to have the ability to export the final output in HD straight from the mobile app for both video and gif - atleast the Gif downloads should be in HD. It would also be great to allow the user to select the desired resolution & format while exporting the content.

These two features would be great to have on this app.

I hope this reaches the team in the right way.

Thanks,
Satisfied Customer

Pleasantly Surprised. I thought this was going to be a semi goofy app partially because of the logo design and was curious to see what their spin was. After loading it felt a little sub par and then it told me there was an upgrade. I installed it and tried some of the basic celebrity type features and the distortions were a little better than others but they encourage minimal movement so it makes sense. I thought I was going to spend 5 minutes total in it but the app actually gives you more control over voice audio photos videos etc and has the potential of being something pretty darn cool. I was impressed with the amount of creations they allowed before having to watch an add. With the adds they were shorter and had an easy exit instead of tricking you to click the sponsor. Each transition and feature with create freedom shows some real thought behind it and not a desperation for funds. I didn’t purchase it yet but will and congrats to your team and I look forward to future enhancements. With the level of controls you have introduced it would be neat to see some facial recognition or LiDAR 3D images or vector images to really make this top of the line . Highly recommend from and IT architect/engineer who works with ML and AI
